warnings: This is a Zn fertilizer study, not CO2 study - mismatched analysis context
Multiple Zn application methods (coating, priming, soil, foliar) - each should be treated as separate treatment vs control
Split-plot design with tillage as main plot and Zn methods as sub-plot - complex interaction effects
Bioavailable Zn is calculated/derived metric - extract raw grain Zn concentration instead
Control is 'No application' treatment, not other Zn treatments
Figure 2 data appears to have error bars but variance type unclear from figure caption
Two-year study with potential year effects
WARNING: SCANNED PDF - Text may have OCR errors
WARNING: VAR-UNCLEAR - Variance type not clearly stated
recon.variance_source: HSD (p ≤0.05) - Tukey's honestly significant difference test used throughout tables
recon.control_definition: No application - no Zn fertilizer applied
recon.treatment_definition: Seven Zn application methods: Zn-coating, Hydro-priming, Zn-priming, Soil application, Hydro-foliar, Zn-foliar (using ZnSO4.7H2O)
recon.potential_tc_confusion: Hydro-priming and Hydro-foliar are positive controls (water only), not Zn treatments
recon.sample_size_source: All the treatments were replicated thrice
recon.factorial_structure: ["Tillage (2 levels: PT, ZT)", "Zn application (7 methods)", "Year (2 years)"]
recon.extraction_guidance: Extract grain Zn concentration data from Figure 2a,b. Compare each Zn method vs 'No application' control within each tillage system separately. Data shows interaction effects between tillage and Zn methods. Use HSD values as variance measure. Ignore hydro-priming and hydro-foliar as these are water-only controls, not Zn treatments. Focus on: Zn-coating, Zn-priming, Soil application, and Zn-foliar vs No application.
